grants.why: The ledger file the grant names has never existed in this branch's history (git log --all on that path is empty). wave03-status.json declares used=0 while pointing at that absent file, and budget.mjs grantView() answers used:0/remaining:4 from an empty fallback ledger. That is a status-document inference, not a reconciled remainder, so capacity is NOT treated as available and any real send is blocked until the ledger is reconstructed from real begin/attempt evidence.

budget.historicalNote: Earlier rounds keep their own accounting. They are reported separately and are never merged into, or used to top up, the wave03 grant.

B2.label: real author/fresh session and run boundary for E
B2.evidenceClassification: package-local, zero model calls (protocol surface verified from codex app-server generate-ts, 751 bindings)

sessionOperations.author: thread/start (persistent) - the no_review arm
sessionOperations.author_continue: thread/resume by real authorThreadId, or thread/fork with lastTurnId cut point
sessionOperations.fresh_session: thread/start with ephemeral true; ignores any authorThreadId passed in

enforced: a fresh reviewer is ephemeral and never carries an author thread id
a continue arm without a real authorThreadId is refused
a billable run with no reservation hook is refused
a hook that refuses or throws refuses the run
only startRun is marked billable; inspect/reconcile/cancel/collectReport never bill
malformed or wrong-subject reports are inconclusive or rejected, never PASS

B3.label: sealed one-shot capsule and host boundary
passing: sealed copy has no .git, no remote config, no hooks
no capsule file shares an inode with the author checkout
links are not replicated into a capsule
scratch is writable and discarded; author files unchanged
input mutation invalidates the original subject digest
manifest binds the frozen subject and every file digest

fail.reason: This filesystem permits linkSync. A caller that hardlinks instead of copying can modify the frozen source. Only copying bytes defends it; the OS does not. Recorded as FAIL and the suite exits non-zero.

B3.hostBoundary: Confirmed a copy is NOT a sandbox: with cwd set to the capsule the author home is still readable by absolute path. Host file/tool/credential/network restrictions are NOT implemented by B and must be enforced separately.
B3.scratchPolicy: Writable scratch inside the capsule is allowed and discarded, per Amendment 01; native read-only is not forced.
